reviewType: fresh independent read-only source review; no independent execution

continuity.coverage: scoped explicit handoff and supplied plan ledger; no broad discovery or private sessions

assessment: No critical or important concrete source defects found in the frozen six-file implementation. Source review supports continuing the planned verification only; it does not establish runtime correctness, acceptance, publication authority or completion.

checks.scope: Four tracked modifications and two new design/plan documents; original functional UI test unchanged. Native selectors, gestures, assertions, retries and stage command ceilings unchanged.
checks.attachment: Existing recognizer target only; UUID token prevents stale probe teardown stopping replacement observer. Stop removes target and invalidates timer. Coordinator deinit retains only its observer for main-queue teardown when needed.
checks.bounds: Open-file and DEBUG gating; process-wide monotonic 240-second deadline, 1600 pan reservations, shared 2097152-byte cap. Metadata consists of bounded class/state/geometry; no text or accessibility payload extraction.
checks.writeErrors: Throwing append latches write-error and emits a fixed NSLog marker, including terminal-record write failures. Open/unavailable files remain absent evidence rather than zero-error evidence.
checks.collector: Runs immediately after strict when selected destination succeeded and job was not cancelled; validates UUID; fixed process/marker predicate; retains nonzero query status, log and receipt through existing artifact/freeze patterns.
checks.budget: Native wrapper bounds total 5670 seconds (1110 + 3630 + 930); marker wrapper 30 seconds; other declared step budgets 720 seconds; sum 6420 seconds = 107 minutes, leaving nominal 60 seconds in unchanged 6480-second job. This is configured accounting, not measured scheduling overhead.
checks.tests: Read actual Bash execution test with real wrapper and fake external xcrun. It asserts status 17, terminal receipt and retained marker log, exact selected destination/predicate/window, plus invalid destination rejection. No tests executed by reviewer.

remainingGates: Run current six-file source contracts and normal-signature native build/targeted original UI test; prior observer compilation is not current-head verification.
Obtain exact-head hosted runtime evidence for iOS26.5/23F77 with all original strict executions and independently retained marker logs/receipts.

Treat failed marker query, missing or capped traces, attachment interruption and unattributed markers as incomplete evidence. The 70-minute query can contain earlier launches; correlate timestamp/PID with strict launch evidence before causal attribution.
Passing phase counts and endpoint hit tests do not prove touch delivery. Timer/hit-test/write overhead can change timing; instrumented success does not establish uninstrumented or device acceptance.
